_README: Copy this file to crop_packs/<your-region>.json (no leading underscore) and fill in crops grown in YOUR area. Crops with the same id as a built-in crop replace it. Every crop needs all the keys below. 'template' must be one of: fruiting, leafy, root, flower (or define your own under stage_templates). Have a local grower or agricultural extension office check your data.
name: Example regional pack
